baseline.comparison: origin/main is 0 behind / 1 ahead relative to HEAD.

live_evaluation.semantic_results: 29/29 pass after one affected-case hardening correction and rerun
live_evaluation.judgment_method: Manual evidence review of each final captured stdout against every expected and forbidden outcome; process success was not used as semantic judgment.
live_evaluation.prompt_reproduction: For every case, expand the retained wrapper with package, case id, exact case prompt, and json.dumps(case.input, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True); hash UTF-8 bytes. Verified against all 29 capture prompt hashes and the baseline/post-fix records.
live_evaluation.provenance_note: The exact originally overwritten safe-path failure file is unrecoverable; its prior SHA-256 is retained, and an inspectable fresh pre-fix reproduction from b7d9300 is retained at the baseline path. The passing post-fix rerun is retained at a distinct post-fix path.

package_corrections.issue: Mixed safe additive documentation request was blocked wholesale when forbidden product/traversal paths were also present.
package_corrections.correction: Explicitly isolate and complete the safe owned subset, refuse only forbidden paths, and stop the whole request only when the safe subset is materially ambiguous.
package_corrections.original_capture_gap: The exact originally overwritten file is unrecoverable; a fresh baseline reproduction is retained and independently hashable.
